observed: FILL: the date of the observation, for example 2026-10-27
via: FILL: how the device was observed, for example web-midi
ports: FILL: the MIDI ports of the device: an object with its inputs and its outputs, each a list of names
identity_reply: FILL: the identity reply of the device, in hexadecimal bytes

device.descriptor: FILL: the id of the device descriptor this fingerprint recognises
